# acme-logistics

## Call debrief (2026-10-28)

Discovery call - Acme Logistics - 2026-10-28
Attendees: Priya Shah (VP Revenue Operations, Acme), Tom Becker (Sales Ops Analyst, Acme), me (founder)

Priya: Our forecast was off by 30% last quarter and our CFO, Martin Gray, had to explain it to the board. That can't happen again.
Priya: I'm sponsoring this evaluation. I already shared your one-pager with my team and set up the internal review for next Tuesday.
Tom: We're also looking at Clari, mainly because our CRO used it at his last company.
Me: Who signs off on a purchase like this?
Tom: I think Martin probably signs anything over $50K, but I'm not sure.
Priya: Honestly, the price you quoted is more than we budgeted for this year.
Me: Understood. What does the approval process look like after your internal review?
Priya: Not sure yet, I'd have to check with procurement. We haven't involved legal.
Next step: Priya to share their evaluation criteria doc by Friday.
